name: account-payables
description: Root-level dispatch scripts. Each script is a thin wrapper around a per-workspace toolchain (pip/pytest/ruff for backend, pnpm for frontend, flutter for mobile). Treat this package.json as a task runner — there are no JS dependencies at root.

scripts.install:all: pnpm run install:backend && pnpm run install:frontend && pnpm run install:mobile
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && set -a && { [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; }; set +a; python main.py
scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; (cd backend && set -a; { [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; }; set +a; exec python main.py) & (cd frontend && exec pnpm dev) & wait'
scripts.dev:all: pnpm run db:up && pnpm run dev
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:mobile
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:mobile
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.idp:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp up -d keycloak
scripts.idp:down: cd backend && docker compose stop keycloak
scripts.idp:logs: cd backend && docker compose logs -f keycloak
scripts.services:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp up -d
scripts.services:down: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp down
scripts.services:reset: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp down -v && docker compose --profile idp up -d
scripts.migrate:all: pnpm run migrate && pnpm run migrate:tenants
